name: create_cpp_stack_class
description: Creates a fixed-capacity int Stack class in a C++ header
prompts: Create a C++ header-only class in a file called stack.h that implements a fixed-capacity stack of ints named `Stack`. Requirements: a default constructor `Stack()` that creates a stack with capacity 100; `void push(int value)` to push a value onto the top; `int pop()` that removes and returns the top value; `int peek() const` that returns the top value without removing it; `bool isEmpty() const` that returns true when the stack has no elements; `bool isFull() const` that returns true when the stack has exactly 100 elements. Do not include a main function in stack.h - it will be #included by other code.

test_setup_files.test_stack.py:
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['g++', '-std=c++17', 'test_stack_main.cpp', '-o', 'test_stack_bin'], check=True)
proc = subprocess.run(['./test_stack_bin'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'stack test failed: exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr[-300:]}'
assert 'PASS' in proc.stdout, f'unexpected output: {proc.stdout!r}'
print('PASS')
